notes:
A page turn from the second tablet no longer occasionally goes missing.

**Turning a page on the second tablet sometimes didn't reach the first one.** The two would sit a page apart until you turned a few pages on the main tablet, which put them right again. Bluetooth doesn't confirm that a message arrived, so an occasional one was simply lost with nothing to notice it had gone.

Each page turn is now sent again twice, a fraction of a second apart. A repeat that isn't needed is ignored, and each one reports where the tablet is at that moment rather than where it was — so a late arrival can never pull you back to a page you have already turned past.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
